title: Arena variants — open plaza + long corridor + cross arena + pit (4 new scenes via generator config switches)
intent: Kaboom Crew currently ships two arenas — the default `start.scene.json` (15×11 standard) and `wide.scene.json`. Players see the same topology every match. Adding 4 generator-driven variants quadruples session variety with zero new mechanic work: open plaza (fewer soft blocks, wider lanes, rewards bomb chains), long corridor (21×7 vertical lane, forces commit decisions), cross arena (two corridors meeting at a centre plaza with bottlenecks), pit (hard-block ring around a smaller play space, diorama frame visible just outside). All four use the existing `kaboom-arena-small.gen.mjs` generator with config switches — same hard-block / soft-block / spawn-cell schema. URL routes `?arena=plaza|corridor|cross|pit` select; multiplayer server picks per-world.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/visual-style.md §9.1` (Procedural geometry — arena variations land as new generator templates) + `gameplay-systems.md §6` round structure (planned MVP-2: arena variants). User direction 2026-05-26: 'content variety' as next-batch focus. After 23-sprint multiplayer + ragdoll arc, the game is mechanically rich but topologically uniform — 4 arena variants close that gap cheap.
acceptanceHints: examples/kaboom-crew/generators/kaboom-arena-small.gen.mjs: extend to accept `variant: 'default' | 'plaza' | 'corridor' | 'cross' | 'pit'` argument. Each variant tweaks dimensions + soft-block density + spawn-cell positions; hard-block lattice pattern stays consistent across variants (preserves the bomberman feel).
Variant specifications:
default — 15×11, ~40% soft-block density, 2 corner spawns. (Unchanged from today.)
plaza — 13×11, ~20% soft-block density (much sparser), 2 corner spawns. Wider lanes, fewer obstacles. Rewards long-range Fire-Up bomb chains.
corridor — 21×7, ~50% soft-block density, 2 short-side spawns (east + west). Vertical movement constrained; players push toward each other.

cross — 17×17 with hard-block walls forming a + shape that creates 4 quadrants connected through a 3×3 centre plaza, ~35% soft-block density in quadrants + 0% in centre, 4 spawns at the quadrant corners. Encourages 2v2 multiplayer.

pit — 11×11 with a hard-block ring around the perimeter (everything outside the inner 9×9 is hard wall), ~45% soft-block density in interior, 2 corner spawns inside the ring. Smaller play space; faster engagements.
examples/kaboom-crew/scenes/: NEW scene files per variant (plaza.scene.json, corridor.scene.json, cross.scene.json, pit.scene.json). Generated via the extended generator, checked in as data.
examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts: read `?arena=<variant>` URL param at boot (default 'default'). Pass to scene loader.
MULTIPLAYER (server side, on top of GDP-2026-05-22-011 server-authoritative gameplay):
Server-config-per-world: `worldConfig.arena: 'default' | 'plaza' | 'corridor' | 'cross' | 'pit'`. Default 'default'.

Per-round arena rotation (optional, feature-flagged): if `worldConfig.rotateArenaPerRound = true`, server picks a different variant each round-restart. Adds session-level variety without players configuring.

Snapshot includes the current arena variant so clients know what to render. Existing scene-load path already handles arena-dependent topology; the per-tick snapshot just confirms which scene was loaded.
HUD: tiny arena-name indicator next to round number in bottom-left (e.g. 'Round 3 — Plaza'). Single-line text, no fancy graphics.
BALANCE CHECKS (each variant must pass on its own):

bot-vs-bot.test.ts variants: run the regression test on each of the 5 arenas. Each variant resolves within the existing 60s budget. If any doesn't (corridor is the risk — tighter lanes), tune that variant's soft-block density or spawn spacing.
Plaza minimum: 6 soft blocks reachable per bomber from spawn within 5 cells.
Corridor: bot AI must find a path between spawns through soft-block destruction (no permanent corridor blockers).
Cross: 4-way connectivity confirmed (no quadrant isolated).
Pit: spawn cells inside the ring, both spawns visible to bot navigation from each other within 3 bomb-clears.

ARENA-SPECIFIC ASSET HOOKS (optional, separate follow-up if time): each arena could have its own `theme.json` (warehouse / factory / dock / lab / bunker per visual-style.md §9.2 — 10 hex codes per theme, no new shaders). Wire in this story OR as a follow-up. Recommended in-this-story since the variant files exist.
UNIT TESTS:
Generator emits valid scenes for all 5 variants (schema-validates via engine:check).
Each variant's soft-block + hard-block counts match the spec.
Spawn cells are non-blocking + non-overlapping per variant.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Dynamic arena (changes mid-round). Out of scope; arenas are static per round.
Player-editable arenas / level editor. Defer indefinitely.
Procedural arena generation beyond the 5 fixed variants. Out — these 5 cover the design budget for now.
Per-variant power-up balance tweaks (e.g. 'plaza spawns more Fire-Up'). Out — drop rates stay constant across variants per gameplay-systems.md §7.1.
